trial_court: Ld. Additional District Judge, Kathua in a petition under Section 13 of J&K Hindu Marriage Act, 1980 (MA No. 117/2016)

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has been guilty of desertion for a period of at least two years.
legal_principles.held: It is well settled that in a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, the burden lies on the petitioner to prove that the respondent has been guilty of desertion for a period of at least two years.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant divorce unless it is satisfied that the respondent has been guilty of desertion for a period of at least two years.
legal_principles.held: This Court will not grant divorce unless it is satisfied that the respondent has been guilty of desertion for a period of at least two years.

outcome.final_order: Let this petition be referred to the Mediation Centre, J&K High Court at Jammu.
